name: Rewrite by selection
description: Rewrite the selected passage, from OpenWriter's right-click menu (the drh plugin's POST /api/drh/rewrite). File parts become the system message; the input template becomes the user message. Placeholders: {text} (the selection), {instruction} (slot 5), {contextBefore} / {contextAfter} (surrounding paragraphs). These slots are run by the OpenWriter drh plugin, not run_slot.py.
